asr.full_text: Dogecoin could fall 4.1% by April 21, based on data from cryptonization. To start, here's how the movement looks at this stage. Dogecoin has slipped by 0.7% today and is currently hovering around $0.09421. Next up, the the analyst perspectives. Tomorrow, CryptoPredictions expects the asset to reach $0.09559, which would be an increase of roughly 1.5%. Dogecoin might move up to $0.09507, according to Digital Coin Price, that's roughly 0.9% up. CoinPriceForecast notes it might be on track for $0.0945, implying a gain of 0.3%. A separate projection by Kryptonization Highlights Dogecoin could fall to $0.09033, an expected decrease of approximately 4.1%. Finally, GovCapital Collector expects a slide to 0.08988$ by April 21. That's 4.6% under current price. This is the best return scenario. That wraps our top projections. Let's dig further. Let's move from the forecasts to the numbers behind them. After pulling together all available outlooks, the market may move between a decrease of 4.6% and a rise of 1.5% . So in the end, Covcapital Collector has the top forecast with 4.6% gain in value by April 21. Put simply, you could earn between $ dollars and 46 dollars for every 1000 dollars you invest. When it comes to probability, CoinPriceForecast has the lead with a 86.8% chance of success. With all forecasts taken together, I've produced a consensus outlook. According to Aggregated forecasts, Dogecoin could fall near 0.09307 dollars, down about 1.2%. Let's break it down step by step. Consensus expectations call for a 1.2% reduction in value. And by that same percentage, your capital could potentially also grow. If you had 1,000 invested, the scenario could point to $12 in return. And according to the combined outlook, this consensus view for Dogecoin comes with a 80.7% probability. To sum up this section, let's see what analysts predict for the 3-day horizon. In this forecast, crypto predictions describes a rising path. Additionally, DigitalCoinPrice believes Dogecoin is on track to rise further. Similarly, Coin Price Forecast points to the price breaking higher in the short term. Kryptonization expects Dogecoin to decline steadily. Similarly, Gov. Capital Collector highlights a bearish short-term picture. Collectively, the forecasts point to Dogecoin remaining calm, with the consensus indicating minimal movement in the short-term. Summing up, 60% of projections indicate a tilt to the upside for Dogecoin. 2 days back, 5 forecasts were published. Let's compare them with the actual numbers. In the end, the daily session finished at $0.09305. 4 of 5 forecasts were right about the move. The daily session finished at $0.09305. Four of five forecasts were right about the move. If we look at pure accuracy, Coindata Flow was the closest. Let's look at the results more closely. Only one forecast fit inside yesterday's price range. Regarding ROI, several results showed gains. Coin price forecast was the strongest performer with 5.8%. Now on screen is the full results summary, how the forecasts performed after fact checking. Also worth noting – Kryptonization had a Forecast probability of 11.3%, 0.0020241 $ accuracy and 5.8% ROI. See if you can spot the forecast that proved most accurate. Now we'll see how Dogecoin stands in tomorrow's expected returns compared with a few others. Dogecoin doesn't reach the top this time as Binance Coin shows the best potential profitability of 1.3%. We're looking at a limited group of 5 coins and the full return comparison among many cryptocurrencies will also be shared on my website and Telegram. And that's the end, friends. If this video was helpful or saved you time, show it with a like. Catch you later.
